sources.entry: LinkWarden - Bookmark and archive manager to store your useful links. (Source Code) MIT Docker/Nodejs
Linkwarden | Collaborative bookmark manager that preserves web pages

summary.one_liner: Linkwarden is a self-hosted, open-source collaborative bookmark manager that saves, archives, and annotates web pages.
summary.what_it_does: Linkwarden organizes bookmarked webpages and articles into collections, sub-collections, and tags, with names and descriptions. For each saved link it automatically captures a screenshot, a PDF, and a single HTML file to guard against link rot. It offers a reader view where text can be highlighted and annotated. Links can optionally be sent to the Wayback Machine (archive.org), and local AI tagging can tag links based on content. Users can collaborate on collections with per-member permissions, share links publicly, and use full-text search, filters, and sorting.
use_cases: save and archive web articles before they disappear
share a curated link collection with a team
keep offline copies of web pages as PDF or screenshot
notable: Saves screenshot, PDF, and single HTML copy of each page for preservation
Reader view with text highlighting and annotation
Collaborative collections with customizable member permissions
Optional Wayback Machine submission and local AI auto-tagging
Native iOS and Android apps plus browser extension, API keys, and RSS subscription
caveats: SSO integration is limited to Enterprise and self-hosted users, per the feature list
Cloud offering is a paid subscription; self-hosting requires deploying and maintaining a server
The mobile apps require a Linkwarden account (Cloud or self-hosted)
